regions.label: INesHeader
regions.evidence: iNES header: NES<1A>, 8x16KiB PRG, 16x8KiB CHR, flags $40 (mapper 4, horizontal).

regions.label: ChrRom
regions.evidence: CHR ROM (16 x 8 KiB) mapped only into PPU pattern space by MMC3 R0-R5; not CPU-addressable, so not code. 2bpp tile patterns (title/logo tiles observed on screen).
